text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
—Out of all the countless Umamusume, how 
many are able to make a truly 
unforgettable debut?

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
1000m on turf:
after falling far behind to 
the very rear, Mihono Bourbon seized 
victory with an explosive burst of late 
speed.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text: A case like hers is exceedingly rare.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
Even the Legend Umamusume began with a 
defeat.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
And from there, she went on to achieve 
something unprecedented:
winning the Grand 
Prix three consecutive times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Chrono Genesis's debut race was at
Kokura 
Racecourse. For that reason, she had 
arrived on-site the day before on 
Saturday.

text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I'd like to head straight to 
Kokura Racecourse like this,
if that's all 
right...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes. Um... To, to watch the races...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-We rarely get to come to Kokura, after 
all... So since we have this special 
chance...

text_block_list.text:

that going out might exhaust them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at Kokura Racecourse, we 
first ate lunch. Left to her own devices, 
Chrono Genesis might skip meals, so this 
was our top priority.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Let's see... How about champon?
choice_data_list: Do you know the specialty foods at...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ah, the steamed pork buns at the 
stand seem to be famous too. Shall we buy 
one of those as well?
choice_data_list: It really feels like Kyushu, nice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After lunch, I headed to the paddock. 
There was one Make Debut race today as 
well.

No. 3 looks nicely relaxed, nice.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! You think so too, Trainer? I was just 
thinking how nice and calm this
atmosphere 
is...

Number 3 looks nice and relaxed. L...

text_block_list.text:
"Especially when it comes to debut races, 
a lot of it really comes down to 
mindset..."

text_block_list.text:
...Though that could also be said for who 
she would be tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Smiles freed from tension... and 
warm applause...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...It's that unique Make Debut atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Both Seeking the Pearl and Ikuno
Dictus... 
made their debuts right here at Kokura, 
didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san was impressive. Taking the lead 
from the start, pulling even further away 
on the homestretch to a crushing 7-length 
victory...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the distances may differ, but I'm 
looking forward to running on the same 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow, I'll finally make my debut...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You only get one Make Debut in your life. 
I want to run without any regrets...!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's make it a great debut ...
Yeah! Let's make it a great debut ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut. Before heading 
to the waiting room, we stopped by the 
paddock.

Yeah! Let's make it a great debut ...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There are already quite a few spectators 
from the first race... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis, who had been looking 
around restlessly, suddenly dashed off.
choice_data_list: Chrono!?

text_block_list.text:
"Ma chérie,
did you sleep well last night? 
My heart was pounding so much I couldn't 
sleep."
choice_data_list: Chrono?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I slept like a log.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. These are my parents.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned out that the people talking
were 
her parents. Flustered, we quickly 
exchanged greetings with each other.
choice_data_list: So you came all the way to Kokura...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Father
text_block_list.text:
Bien sûr! Today is the very first page of 
her racing history—we must etch it firmly 
into both record and memory!
choice_data_list: You came all the way to Kokura...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Rest assured. I won't miss a single 
chance to photograph you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so,
Chrono Genesis's mother readied 
the telephoto camera and clicked the 
shutter. —That hefty lens belonged to her 
daughter's camera.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
My mother is a chronologist.
Her influence 
is what got me interested in history...

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Leave the specialty to the specialist, 
Trainer. We'll handle recording the races.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I told you you didn't have to, since 
you're busy.

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You and your Trainer should be focusing 
only on the race.

text_block_list.text:

into the waiting room—
only to start pacing 
restlessly back and forth.

Chrono Genesis quietly settled into her 
seat. However—

text_block_list.text:
...Um, let's see... Yup, it's definitely 
this room! After the race,
the locker door 
was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She once again lost herself in
reminiscing 
about tales of past Umamusume.

text_block_list.text: She's completely lost her focus...!
choice_data_list: —Chrono...

yesterday. Hence, it has been weighing on 
my mind ever since.

her 
race-fan mindset yet.

Her admiration for racing history has
